title: Police Casualties
pdf_title: CHAPTER-15 POLICE CASUALTIES 15.1.1 The very nature of Policeman's job generates animosity, thereby, endangering their own life in discharge of their Official duties. This includes operations against terrorists, extremists, robbers, dacoits or the resultant accidents. At times, police personnel are not able to cope up with the work culture and are, therefore, driven to commit suicide. 15.1.2 The State, UT & City-wise information relating to Police Personnel Killed or injured on duty during various operations and accidents is provided in Table-85, while the rank-wise casualties or injuries sustained by these personnel is given in Table-86 from the current issue additional data on age-groups of Police personnel who died natural deaths or un-natural deaths are also compiled and presented through Tables 85-A & 85-B. 15.1.3 A total number of 2,730 Police Personnel died during the year. 932 were killed while performing their duties, while, 1,652 died natural deaths and 146 committed suicides. Police Personnel killed on duty 15.2.1 The casualties include Civil as well as the Armed Personnel of various States & UTs who sacrificed their lives while performing their bonafide duties during the year. The magnitude of Police fatalities while performing their duties increased by whooping 47.7 percent as compared to previous year. Of the 932 Police Personnel killed, 908 Personnel belonged to 25 States and 24 Personnel to the 7 Union Territories. 15.2.2 While 53.5 per cent of the casualties occurred due to `Accidents', 19.0 per cent were killed by criminals. 'Anti- Terrorist/Extremists' operations claimed 21.5 percent while `Anti-Dacoity' Operations accounted for 2.8 per cent of the Police casualties. 15.2.3 Jammu & Kashmir suffered the highest casualties (104) followed by Uttar Pradesh (95), and Punjab (85). The N.C.T. of Delhi reported 19 deaths out of a total of 24 reported from the 7 Union Territories. From the State of Sikkim, the Union Territory of A & N Island, Daman & Diu, Lakshadweep and Pondicherry, no Policeman was reported killed on duty during the year.
